stories.headline: Nvidia backs up to $105B in lease guarantees for OpenAI's 8 GW Ohio data center campus

key_facts.fact: On August 17, 2026 Nvidia filed an 8-K disclosing multiple residual value guaranties with SoftBank-owned SB Energy covering leases for roughly 4.25 gigawatts of IT load at the PORTS-Pike Technology Campus in Pike County, Ohio, with an aggregate payment obligation capped at $105 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA's aggregate payment obligation is cumulatively capped at $105 billion for its initial commitment under the Agreements.

key_facts.fact: An OpenAI affiliate is the tenant under a 20-year lease and will deploy Nvidia's full-stack DSX AI factory platform; Nvidia can provide credit support for an additional ~3.8 GW at its sole discretion.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI, as the tenant, will utilize capacity at the Portsmouth Site supporting approximately 4.25 gigawatts of IT load to deploy NVIDIA's full-stack DSX AI factory platform

key_facts.fact: Nvidia is also investing $1.5 billion in SB Energy, joining existing investors SoftBank Group and OpenAI, and becomes the exclusive compute supplier at the site.
key_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA to invest $1.5B in SB Energy now to support SB Energy's growth and commitments to the Ohio community

key_facts.fact: SB Energy and SoftBank will build at least 10 GW of new power generation, yielding 8 IT-GW of AI factory capacity, and invest at least $4.2 billion in regional grid infrastructure with AEP Ohio; capacity comes online in phases starting 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: SB Energy and SoftBank will build at least 10 GW of new energy generation, which results in 8 IT-GW of AI factory capacity, and invest at least $4.2 billion in new regional grid infrastructure

key_facts.fact: Jensen Huang wrote that each generation of Nvidia systems deployed at PORTS-Pike could represent about 1.5 million GPUs, or roughly $150 billion to $200 billion in Nvidia revenue, and that OpenAI's existing and planned commitments represent about 12 GW of Nvidia compute through 2030.
key_facts.excerpt: Each generation of NVIDIA AI factory systems deployed at PORTS-Pike could represent approximately 1.5 million NVIDIA GPUs, or approximately $150 billion to $200 billion in NVIDIA revenue.

key_facts.fact: Huang addressed circular-financing criticism directly, saying 'Is this circular financing? No. OpenAI will pay the lease.'
key_facts.excerpt: No. OpenAI will pay the lease.

key_facts.fact: The campus reindustrializes the decommissioned Portsmouth Gaseous Diffusion Plant, a former uranium enrichment site spanning private and federal land, developed with AEP Ohio, the US Department of Energy and the Department of Commerce.
key_facts.excerpt: SB Energy's PORTS-Pike Technology Campus is reindustrializing the decommissioned Portsmouth Gaseous Diffusion Plant and the surrounding area

key_facts.fact: Nvidia pays only if OpenAI defaults or becomes insolvent, covering the shortfall between a guaranteed minimum lease value and what SB Energy recovers by re-letting or selling the site; the guarantee expires if OpenAI achieves a satisfactory credit rating.
key_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA will pay an amount generally equal to any shortfall between the guaranteed minimum value of a lease ... and amounts recovered through a replacement lease or sale.

stories.headline: AI inference chip startup Etched raises $700M led by Jane Street at a $21B valuation

key_facts.fact: Jane Street is leading a new $700 million funding round in Etched that values the AI inference chip startup at $21 billion, according to the Wall Street Journal.
key_facts.excerpt: Now, Jane Street is leading a new $700M funding round that values the startup at $21B.

key_facts.fact: Jane Street is also Etched's first customer, and the company has booked more than $1 billion in orders.
key_facts.excerpt: Etched, a semiconductor startup, has signed its first customer with Jane Street and has booked over $1B in orders

key_facts.fact: Etched took 44 days from receiving test chips from TSMC to running inference workloads on them, a process the WSJ says usually takes six months or longer.
key_facts.excerpt: The startup took 44 days after getting its test chips from TSMC to have them running interference workloads, a process that usually takes six months or longer.

key_facts.fact: About 15% of Etched's 400 employees previously worked at Nvidia, and the company has been recruiting aggressively from the market leader.
key_facts.excerpt: about 15% of the company's 400 employees previously worked at Nvidia and it has recruited aggressively from the market-leader

key_facts.fact: The new valuation is roughly double the $10.3 billion mark Etched set on July 23, 2026 when it closed a $300 million Sequoia-led Series C with a16z, Jane Street, SK Hynix and Diffusion.
key_facts.excerpt: Etched ... today announced $300M in new financing at a $10.3B valuation less than one month after emerging from stealth.

key_facts.fact: Etched, founded in 2022 by Harvard dropouts Gavin Uberti, Chris Zhu and Robert Wachen, builds rack-scale inference clusters around its transformer-specific Sohu chip and was valued at just $5 billion in December 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: Etched was previously valued at $5 billion in December when it raised a $500 million round, meaning it has doubled its valuation in about seven months.

stories.headline: Unitree unveils 'Superman' humanoid and sets Shanghai debut for August 19

key_facts.fact: Unitree unveiled a new humanoid robot called 'Superman' on Monday, August 17, days before its Shanghai listing.
key_facts.excerpt: China's Unitree unveiled a new high-speed robot it dubbed "Superman" on Monday, days before becoming the first general-purpose robotics company to list on mainland China's stock market.

key_facts.fact: Superman has 0.85-meter legs, performs a 2-meter standing vertical jump and reaches a top speed of 12.66 meters per second, beating the human world records in both events (1.90 m and Usain Bolt's 12.42 m/s peak).
key_facts.excerpt: The robot achieves a standing jump of more than 2 meters – above the human world record of 1.90 meters – and a top speed of 12.66 meters per second, exceeding Usain Bolt's peak recorded speed of 12.42 meters per second.

key_facts.fact: Unitree says it developed the entire robot from the ground up in just over three months.
key_facts.excerpt: The team developed the entire system from the ground up in just over three months, and says there's still plenty of room for improvement in the months ahead.

key_facts.fact: A filing to the Shanghai bourse on Monday confirmed Unitree will start trading on the STAR Market on August 19, the first general-purpose robotics company to list on mainland China's stock market.
key_facts.excerpt: China's most high-profile humanoid robot maker Unitree will make its stock market debut in Shanghai on August 19, a filing to the bourse showed on Monday.

key_facts.fact: Unitree raised 6.1 billion yuan ($905 million) in its IPO the previous week; the retail tranche was more than 8,000 times oversubscribed, a record for the STAR Market.
key_facts.excerpt: the IPO was more than 8,000 times oversubscribed by retail investors, a record for Shanghai's STAR Market for tech startups

key_facts.fact: IPO proceeds will fund robot model R&D, prototype development, new product innovation and construction of an intelligent robot manufacturing base.
key_facts.excerpt: Proceeds from the IPO will fund four core projects: intelligent robot model research and development, robot prototype development, new intelligent robot product innovation, and the construction of an intelligent robot manufacturing base.

key_facts.fact: The unveiling coincided with the opening of the World Robot Conference in Beijing and precedes the second World Humanoid Robot Games, opening August 22 with more than 2,000 robots from 16 countries.
key_facts.excerpt: The debut is timed to the second World Humanoid Robot Games, which open in Beijing on August 22 – this weekend – where Superman is expected to participate in athletic events alongside more than 2,000 robots from 16 countries.

key_facts.fact: Unitree has not disclosed a test protocol covering payload, surface conditions or repeatability; the figures are company claims and do not indicate the robot has entered commercial production.
key_facts.excerpt: The figures are company claims and do not indicate that the robot has entered commercial production.

stories.headline: Memory crunch bites: Xiaomi's Q2 profit falls as 2027 DRAM allocations sell out

key_facts.fact: Xiaomi reported second-quarter 2026 revenue of RMB 108.9 billion, down 6.1% year over year, with net profit down 20.3% to RMB 9.5 billion and adjusted net profit down 42.6% to RMB 6.2 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Xiaomi Corporation reported a 6.1% year-over-year revenue decline to RMB 108.9 billion for the second quarter of 2026. Net profit for the period fell 20.3% to RMB 9.5 billion, while adjusted net profit dropped 42.6% to RMB 6.2 billion

key_facts.fact: Xiaomi's smartphone gross margin compressed to 8.5% from 11.5% a year earlier, primarily due to soaring memory costs; shipments fell 26.5% to 31.2 million units even as average selling price hit a record RMB 1,351.
key_facts.excerpt: smartphone gross margins compressed to 8.5% from 11.5% a year ago, primarily due to soaring memory costs

key_facts.fact: Semiannual reports filed with South Korea's Financial Supervisory Service on Tuesday showed Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix combined inventories grew by more than 22 trillion won ($15.5 billion) in the first half of 2026 versus the end of last year.
key_facts.excerpt: their combined inventories grew by more than 22 trillion won ($15.5 billion) in the first half of this year compared with the end of last year

key_facts.fact: Samsung's semiconductor (DS) division inventories climbed 32.1%, from 28.81 trillion won to 38.06 trillion won, with work-in-progress goods up 7.64 trillion won.
key_facts.excerpt: inventories climbed 32.1%, from 28.81 trillion won to 38.06 trillion won, an increase of 9.

key_facts.fact: Next year's allocations from the three major memory makers were already sold out as of the first half of 2026, with buyers paying deposits in advance to secure supply; Samsung, Micron and SanDisk have also sold out 2027 NAND supply.
key_facts.excerpt: next year's allocations from the three major memory makers were already sold out as of the first half of this year. Buyers are said to have paid deposits in advance to secure supply.

key_facts.fact: TrendForce says Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron are all negotiating higher HBM prices for 2027 and that HBM demand will continue to outpace supply that year.
key_facts.excerpt: Market research firm TrendForce said Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix and Micron are all in negotiations to sell HBM at higher prices in 2027, and that HBM demand will continue to outpace supply that year.

key_facts.fact: Retail memory prices have climbed roughly 500% in 12 months, with 128GB of DDR5 now selling for $3,399 — up to 10 times the lowest prices ever tracked.
key_facts.excerpt: Memory prices climb 500% in 12 months, up to 10x the lowest ever tracked prices — 128GB of DDR5 now $3,399

stories.headline: AI data center builder Crusoe in IPO talks with four banks amid $3B raise at $35B

key_facts.fact: Crusoe, a data center developer and power supplier, is in IPO talks with at least four Wall Street banks, Axios Pro reported on August 17, 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Crusoe, a data center developer and power supplier, is in IPO talks with at least four Wall Street banks, Axios Pro has learned.

key_facts.fact: The company is meeting with Bank of America, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan, though a formal bake-off has not yet begun.
key_facts.excerpt: Crusoe is meeting with BofA, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan, though one source notes that a formal bake-off hasn't commenced.

key_facts.fact: JPMorgan is advising on Crusoe's $3 billion pre-IPO fundraise, which is set to value the company at $35 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Crusoe is in IPO talks with at least four Wall Street banks, including JPMorgan, which is advising on its $3B pre-IPO fundraise set to value it at $35B

key_facts.fact: Crusoe was reported in early July to be raising about $3 billion at a valuation in the $30 billion range; it was valued at roughly $10 billion in an October Series E co-led by Valor Equity Partners and Mubadala Capital.
key_facts.excerpt: investors expect the value to fall within the $30 billion range, including the new investments ... The company was valued at about $10 billion in October.

key_facts.fact: Crusoe builds and operates large AI data centers with contracts to supply computing power to companies including Meta Platforms and Oracle, and has raised about $2.77 billion to date; Nvidia participated in its last round.
key_facts.excerpt: Crusoe's last funding round included the participation of Nvidia Corp., Salesforce Ventures and more than a dozen others. The company has raised a total of $2.77 billion to date.

stories.headline: Google tells suppliers all Pixel hardware will be made outside China from 2027

key_facts.fact: Google has told suppliers it plans to have all of its Pixel smartphones, watches and wireless earbuds produced outside of China starting next year, Nikkei Asia reported on August 18, 2026 (JST).
key_facts.excerpt: Google has told suppliers it plans to have all of its Pixel smartphones, watches and wireless earbuds produced outside of China starting next year amid ongoing Washington-Beijing tensions, Nikkei Asia has learned.

key_facts.fact: The shift is driven by ongoing US-China tensions, with production moving to Vietnam and India as Google aims to increase smartphone shipments.
key_facts.excerpt: US tech giant shifts to Vietnam, India as it aims to increase smartphone shipments

key_facts.fact: Google's Pixel portfolio covered by the move includes smartphones, smartwatches and wireless earbuds.
key_facts.excerpt: Google's Pixel portfolio of devices includes smartphones, smartwatches and wireless earbuds.

stories.headline: Apple's camera-equipped AirPods surface in a macOS 26.7 release-candidate demo video

key_facts.fact: MacRumors found a short demo video inside the macOS Tahoe 26.7 release candidate, seeded on Monday August 17, showing a man using camera-equipped AirPods with Visual Intelligence.
key_facts.excerpt: Apple is working on camera-equipped AirPods that appear to be nearly ready to launch, based on a video MacRumors found in the macOS Tahoe 26.7 release candidate.

key_facts.fact: In the demo a man holds up a book so the AirPods camera can read the title; the voiceover says 'With Visual Intelligence, your world becomes savable. See something you like? Just ask me to save it for later.'
key_facts.excerpt: "With Visual Intelligence, your world becomes savable. See something you like? Just ask me to save it for later," says the voiceover text.

key_facts.fact: The camera feeds Visual Intelligence so Siri can answer questions about the wearer's surroundings; the software warns users with a 'Hair Detected' style alert if the camera is covered.
key_facts.excerpt: If hair is covering the AirPods up, you'll receive an alert. "To get the most accurate information about things in your environment, make sure AirPods are not covered," it says.

key_facts.fact: The device carries the codename B790, previously mentioned by Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, who suggested it could launch as soon as September alongside the iPhone 18 Pro line.
key_facts.excerpt: The camera-equipped AirPods have the codename B790, which was also previously mentioned by Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. Gurman suggested the AirPods could launch as soon as September

key_facts.fact: The same release candidate contains references to a broader list of unreleased Apple products, including a Home Hub, home accessories, new Beats, AirPods Pro 4 and Apple Intelligence in China.
key_facts.excerpt: The macOS Tahoe 26.7 release candidate that Apple seeded today has references to several unreleased products, from home devices to iPhones, iPads, AirPods, and Macs.
